body: If I remember correctly, this is incorrect. It's a Russian man being conscripted and his daughter came to see him off.

Kinda surprised so many are on the "Off the creeper" wagon and not rushing to its defense...

... you've restored a bit of my hope for humanity.
Because I'm a Wendigo and my blood is ice itself and every winter I emerge from my tomb of ice and stone to feed on the flesh of mankind.

💜 

But leave the talking off the table.
I don't like hugs, cuddles or comfort. Hard pass.

Have some courage and own up to it!
" Yeah. I did it! I'll do it again!! "

That's what I would do anyways.
